rationale: Lydia bridges developer experience and AI tooling at Anthropic's Claude Code team, while Era is building edge intelligence infrastructure and open-source AI systems at Edge — both are deeply invested in making AI accessible and composable for developers. Lydia's conviction that agentic coding tools fundamentally change engineering aligns with Era's focus on sovereign, on-device AI and production-grade open-source stacks, and they share JavaScript/TypeScript as core tech. This is a natural pairing for exploring how DX strategy and technical education can accelerate adoption of edge AI infrastructure.
intro_message: Lydia Hallie, meet Era Qian — you're both building the developer-facing layer of the next generation of AI, one through tooling and education at Anthropic, the other through edge intelligence and open-source infrastructure at Edge.
